body: Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate and writes a reference for the judge. Across three benchmarks, DeRef improves overall argument AUROC for all judges tested. On the controlled test, it raises AUROC from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.
summaryZh: 本文研究了LLM智能体在工具调用验证中存在的“推导鸿沟”（Derivation Gap）问题。研究发现，当输入中缺乏明确的参考文本时，验证模型往往难以正确评估工具参数，即使参数本身是正确的。这种现象在多种模型中普遍存在。为解决此问题，作者提出了DeRef模型，通过预先生成参考信息来辅助验证，显著提升了工具调用参数评估的准确性。该研究为构建更稳健的智能体工具调用验证机制提供了重要技术路径。

glossary.explanationZh: 工具调用，指智能体通过调用外部函数或API执行特定任务。
推导鸿沟，指验证模型因缺乏输入参考而无法正确判断参数正确性的现象。
受试者工作特征曲线下面积，用于衡量分类模型的性能。
函数模式，定义了工具调用的参数结构与默认值。
